signals.title: @onlythedeadknow: Data Centers + Spectrum + Space + Energy - Genesis Project/Genesis Mission USA has Argus Accrete USA has/had Artemis USA has GenAI USA has P
signals.content: Data Centers + Spectrum + Space + Energy - Genesis Project/Genesis Mission USA has Argus Accrete USA has/had Artemis USA has GenAI USA has Project Maven / Maven Smart System USA has Agent Network USA has TITAN USA has GSA USAi USA has Genesis Mission and DOE Project Genesis USA has Rhombus Guardian + Artemis Copilot/OpenAI Amazon Nova Israel has AI21 Labs Maestro, Lightricks (LTX-Video, open-weight), DictaLM 2.0 and the Hebrew LLM Leaderboard Israel has Dicta IDF’s Gospel/Habsora and Lavender Israel punches well above its weight in the broader AI ecosystem (hundreds of genAI startups, heavy activity in cyber/AI infrastructure, silicon contributions via companies later acquired by Nvidia/Intel/Amazon, and high per-capita adoption of models like Claude) China has Hunyuan (Tencent), Doubao/Seed (ByteDance), Pangu (Huawei), Yi (https://t.co/h5yak9j6uH), Step (StepFun), SenseNova (SenseTime), Spark (iFlytek), InternLM (Shanghai AI Lab), Skywork (Kunlun). All have large scale genomic and biologic databases. Just a few in the U.S. Million Veteran Program Joint Pathology Center DOW VA Genesis MHR system DOW/DISA - Umbrella Cloud System previously JEDI then JWCC (Joint Warfighting Cloud Capability) - Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle - JWCC Unified Cloud Marketplace (UCM) Datasets + AI = Biotech and new material science 🧬 NIH All of Us; the DoD Serum Repository (~60M+ specimens arguably the more consequential one for your exposure research); Millennium Cohort Study; dbGaP and the Genomic Data Commons; Vanderbilt BioVU; Kaiser RPGEH; Regeneron Genetics Center. MVP itself has passed the one-million mark. China: the China National GeneBank in Shenzhen — over 10 million samples and a data center scaling toward 500 petabytes — plus the National Genomics Data Center under CNCB/Chinese Academy of Sciences, which now runs BIG Search across NGDC, NCBI and EBI, and the Oxford-linked China Kadoorie Biobank (500,000 participants). Israel: Clalit and Maccabi longitudinal HMO records (the datasets behind the 2021 vaccine-effectiveness studies), MIDGAM biobank, MDClone synthetic-data infrastructure, and a NIS 44 million government investment launching six national databases for personalized medicine, alongside a consortium with NVIDIA, Teva, Sheba and others for AI in biology and drug discovery. PRECISE-SG100K, run by Precision Health Research Singapore The recent trip to China by President Trump included all the top Tech Leaders and one man very interested in genomics. Jacob Thaysen, CEO of Illumina. Illumina partnered with PRECISE in 2022 to sequence and analyze the 100,000 genomes SEA-LION, from AI Singapore under the National Multimodal LLM Programme. v4 is built on Google’s Gemma 3 27B with 128k context and image-plus-text input. The detail that should interest you: there is a parallel Qwen-SEA-LION-v4 built on Alibaba’s Qwen, covering Burmese, Filipino, Indonesian, Malay, Tamil, Thai and Vietnamese. Singapore is running American and Chinese foundations side by side in the same national program — a deliberate non-alignment posture. They’ve since added SEA-Guard (safety) and agentic v4.5 models. Malaysia - Johor is the pivot. 42 approved data centre projects worth roughly $39 billion as of mid-2025, with Chinese-linked operators holding most capacity — Bridge Data Centres (formerly Chindata) at 32%, DayOne (formerly GDS) at 29%, ByteDance as anchor tenant. The current NDAA made data sharing between the United States and Israel official. Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and most the rest of the big tech leaders have stated synthetic RNA, gene editing, and other tools may be the next big thing. I agree Claude it is complicated: “It’s linkage: genomes tied to longitudinal clinical outcomes tied to exposure history. On that metric MVP and the Israeli HMO records are worth more per record than anything sheer scale produces, which is exactly why they’re the ones being fenced.”

signals.title: @Barong369: 🇨🇳 China: Chinese military researchers with ties to the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) have used versions of AI models from U.S. providers O
signals.content: 🇨🇳 China: Chinese military researchers with ties to the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) have used versions of AI models from U.S. providers OpenAI and Anthropic to train domestic military AI systems. This is according to a Reuters investigation based on an analysis of more than 80 Chinese scientific papers and patents. According to the report, the researchers used a technique known as “model distillation” to develop smaller AI models for surveillance tasks, drones, combat planning, and cyber operations. A paper published last year by researchers from PLA Unit 96941—a Beijing-based unit specializing in military intelligence and cyber warfare—describes, for example, the use of OpenAI’s GPT-3.5 to process sensitive military source code. U.S. authorities accuse some Chinese actors of using this method to deliberately extract capabilities from U.S. AI models, thereby violating export controls and intellectual property rights. China, meanwhile, has rejected the allegations, claiming that Washington is engaging in “AI hegemony.” Beijing also argued that U.S. companies engage in exactly the same practice.

signals.content: We believe the Sovereign AI revolution is the most important movement since the advent of LLMs. This is a rebellion against the harvesting and migration of institutions’ and individuals’ data into the weights of closed models, only for their own knowledge to be rented back or used to replace them. It is a rebellion against the statistical tendency of these models towards the average and mediocrity. We believe every great institution is differentiated, and sovereignty is what enables that institution to own, protect, and compound its differentiation. We are the leader because we have been doing this for twenty years. Everything we have built has been in service of giving institutions maximal control over their operations, data, decisions, and their future. We are the sovereignty company. We do not exist by extracting value from our customers. We are confident enough to take on the risk of failure, and unlike any other company, we succeed only when our customers do. We are pushing the frontier and creating genuine impact in the world’s most important institutions. Thank you to all the Palantirians currently building, to our hundreds of commercial and government partners around the world, and to those who paved the way. The revolution is just beginning. Join us. https://t.co/w4YSaGDbxF
